thread:
maria: auditor (PwC) just pinged — they want a playback of the RBAC change from last Tuesday + sampling of KMS key-rotation logs and vuln triage notes. Can someone own pulling a minimal export? Need a short narrative for context.

sam: I can. which scope? org-level or prod-only?

irene: prod-only + staging snapshot should be fine. auditor only needs evidence for control CC3 (change management) and CC7 (crypto key lifecycle).

sam: ok grabbing rolebinding diffs + k8s audit logs for the window. will prepare anonymized manifest. ETA 45m

maria: @sam add a short line about the emergency access procedure we used yesterday — auditor asked about justification and approvals

sam: will include screenshot of PR + approver + deployment tag. also include `kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml` for historical state.

sec-bot: compliance-checklist: required artifacts: change PR, approver log, KMS rotation event IDs, audit-log slices, vuln-triage ticket links

irene: for KMS, export from CloudKMS: `gcloud kms keys versions list --key=redwood-prod-enc --location=global --keyring=prod-kr --filter="state:ENABLED OR state:DESTROY_SCHEDULED"`

sam: pulled logs. small question: do we provide raw SIEM slices or a sanitized CSV? auditor said "readable timeline + evidence hashes"

maria: hashes preferred. give raw slices to security PM (IR folder) and hashed copies to auditor. redact customer IDs.

sam: noted. vuln triage note: CVE-2025-xyz assigned, patched in 1.2.3, mitigation timeline attached: ticket #SEC-4123. Attaching short summary.

maria: perfect. once export is ready, drop in `s3://redwood-audit-deliverables/pwc-march-2026/` and DM auditor link. Also add a README.md with chain-of-custody steps.

sam: uploading now, will DM link when done :thumbsup:

auditor-jane: thanks team — that's exactly what we need. once we review we may request a few deeper samples but this should cover SOC2 change control evidence.

maria: thanks @auditor-jane. tagging legal and compliance for visibility: @leo @anika

leo: noted

anika: thanks, team. cc: retention window for these artifacts is 7 years per request — confirm backup policy? :eyes:

maria: backup policy confirmed — s3 lifecycle + glacier cold copy, will include pointer in README

sam: done. s3 link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-audit-deliverables/pwc-march-2026/rbac-playback-1769875533.zip

sam: included hashes: sha256 sums in README. redacted customer ids replaced with <REDACTED-ORG> tags.

auditor-jane: received link, starting review. quick Q: can you provide the CI/CD run id for the deployment that triggered the RBAC change?

irene: CI run id is `ci-20260312-4598` — included in PR metadata.

auditor-jane: great. if we need anything else we'll reopen thread. thanks everyone.

maria: closing loop — leaving a note in control mapping doc about this sample: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Sec/Control+Mapping+v2

sec-bot: ticket SEC-4123 status updated to 'evidence-provided'

sam: thanks y'all
